note: Universal Violante & Sons boilerplate exclusions, pulled from real past proposals. Start every new proposal's exclusions list with these, then add scope-specific items (thickness assumptions, what's not included in the trade scope, etc.) after.
universal: Pricing is based on normal working hours and open shop labor.
Existing conditions concealed within walls, ceilings, shafts, or floors are excluded. Any unforeseen conditions encountered shall be treated as a change order.
Existing structural deficiencies or code deficiencies discovered during construction are excluded.
Building services and fees are not included.
Asbestos and hazardous material testing and removal is not included.
